Chapter 1 Synthetic General Provisions
Article 1 Passengers shall board and leave a public bus at designated stops and keep their personal luggage safe. The driver shall inspect the condition of the vehicle. If an abnormal road condition is observed, the driver shall stop the vehicle and report it to the dispatcher.
